summary: 以单局为单位的肉鸽设计：单局结构、永久死亡、局外成长、种子与每日挑战、回合顺序和对称视野。 Designs run-based roguelikes and roguelites in any engine: run structure, permadeath, meta-progression, seeded and daily runs, turn order and symmetric field of view. Use for NetHack- or Hades-style games, or runs that feel cheap. Pair with `procedural-gen` for dungeon generation and `save-systems` for run vs meta saves. Not for roguelike deckbuilders (`card-game`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill roguelike，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for NetHack- or Hades-style games, or runs that feel cheap.
Workflow: Settle the type with the user; Lay out the run; Split state; Seed everything.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：procedural-gen 用 gene_gdsk_procedural_gen_v1，save-systems 用 gene_gdsk_save_systems_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
